name: local-python-agent-web-server
summary: Run a single-file Python web server locally on port 4777 backed by Anthropic API for an AI employee dashboard.
steps: Place config.json containing Anthropic API key in project root directory.
Launch single-file Python web server script.
Access agent UI locally via Chrome at localhost:4777.
jarvis_use: Serve lightweight local UI dashboards for desktop agent control without heavy web frameworks.

name: claude-code-prompt-pack-app-generation
summary: Build a full local web app agent sequentially using a structured 5-step prompt pack in Claude Code CLI.
steps: Open Claude Code CLI inside a fresh project directory.
Paste Step 1 prompt ('The Office') to create local Python web server and UI on port 4777.
Paste Step 2 & 3 prompts ('Your Voice & Approve Desk') to add voice tuning module and approval queue UI.
Paste Step 4 prompt ('The Weekly Pitch') to enable automatic weekly content scheduling.
Paste Step 5 prompt ('Make Him Yours') to add tone sliders and niche customization options.
jarvis_use: Bootstrap custom local agent tools and UIs rapidly via sequential system prompt templates.

name: prompt-driven-claude-code-self-healing
summary: Fix runtime script and UI bugs by instructing Claude Code CLI with raw error text instead of manually debugging code.
steps: Identify runtime exception or unexpected behavior on the local server.
Pass plain error description prompt to active Claude Code CLI session: 'Something's wrong with my SPARK... Fix it.'
Allow Claude Code to inspect codebase, edit files, and verify server restart.
jarvis_use: Enable automated self-correction of local agent scripts using Claude Code CLI.

name: creator-voice-cloning-prompting
summary: Fine-tune LLM content generation style by supplying top-performing past post samples into a dedicated prompt training field.
steps: Collect 3 to 10 top-performing social media post copy samples.
Paste post samples into the VOICE FILE text area inside agent Settings.
Trigger voice learning prompt to analyze rhythm, hooks, formatting, and vocabulary patterns.
jarvis_use: Match specific personal or corporate writing tones across generated outbound messages.

name: hype-and-spice-tone-sliders
summary: Control post enthusiasm and boldness using visual UI sliders alongside niche keyword settings.
steps: Open Settings tab on local agent UI.
Adjust HYPE slider (0 to 100) to control promotional tone and energy.
Adjust SPICE slider to control bold or provocative positioning.
Input target market niche string and save settings.
jarvis_use: Provide interactive UI sliders to modify LLM system prompt parameters on the fly.

name: weekly-content-pitch-prompt
summary: Generate a weekly content schedule categorized into balanced educational, promotional, behind-the-scenes, and engagement posts.
steps: Click 'PITCH ME THE WEEK' button in dashboard.
Agent retrieves creator voice file and niche configuration.
Agent generates 6 balanced post drafts tailored to target channels (3 educational, 1 promotional, 1 behind-the-scenes, 1 engagement).
jarvis_use: Automate routine content planning according to predefined category ratios.

name: human-in-the-loop-approve-desk
summary: Buffer AI-generated drafts in an interactive approval queue with APPROVE, EDIT, REJECT, and REDO IT actions.
steps: Agent populates generated post drafts into the APPROVE card queue.
Review post copy, generated visual assets, and generation report modal.
Click APPROVE to publish/stage post, EDIT to modify copy inline, REJECT to discard, or REDO IT to request AI revision with feedback.
jarvis_use: Enforce strict human oversight over autonomous agent output before public execution.

name: dm-deliverability-cta-link-pattern
summary: Preserve direct message deliverability on Instagram by embedding landing page links in CTA buttons instead of DM body text.
steps: Write custom DM text response omitting plain text HTTP/HTTPS links.
Create a CTA button object with a brief label (max 20 characters).
Attach target URL directly to the CTA button property.
jarvis_use: Prevent outreach DMs from triggering platform spam filters during automated lead delivery.

name: instagram-auto-dm-keyword-trigger-setup
summary: Set up automated direct messaging triggered by specific keyword comments on Instagram posts.
steps: Select Instagram target channel in Auto DM desk.
Define trigger keywords (e.g., JARVIS, GUIDE).
Enter custom DM text body and set embedded CTA button label and destination link.
Click 'CREATE, GOES LIVE' to deploy rule to Blotato cloud runner.
jarvis_use: Automate lead capture and asset delivery from social engagement comments.

name: randomized-comment-reply-rotation
summary: Rotate between multiple automated public comment responses to evade bot detection filters.
steps: Open Comment Reply section within an Auto DM rule configuration.
Input 3 to 5 distinct response sentence templates confirming DM delivery.
Enable automated comment reply toggle.
Save settings to dynamically alternate responses upon comment triggers.
jarvis_use: Avoid account rate limiting and bot flags during automated comment engagement.

name: blotato-unified-social-api-integration
summary: Connect local web applications to 9+ social networks for publishing and DM automation using Blotato API key.
steps: Log in to my.blotato.com and navigate to Settings -> API.
Copy Blotato API key.
Connect target social accounts (Instagram, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, Threads, Facebook, YouTube, Pinterest, Bluesky).
Paste API key into local application Settings panel to activate webhooks and posting functions.
jarvis_use: Integrate Blotato API/MCP to provide Jarvis with multi-channel social media execution capability.

name: higgsfield-ai-visual-asset-generation
summary: Generate multi-aspect-ratio images and carousel assets via Higgsfield AI Studio API.
steps: Obtain Higgsfield API Key and Secret key.
Configure credentials inside agent Studio settings panel.
Submit creative generation prompt from content dashboard.
Agent queries Higgsfield API to render assets matching platform dimensions (master, IG story, square).
jarvis_use: Automate visual slide and image generation inside media creation pipelines.

name: crm-deals-kanban-board-automation
summary: Manage inbound DM leads on a built-in Kanban deals board with DM Watch and Autopilot controls.
steps: Track inbound conversations across pipeline columns: NEW, TALKING, QUOTED, WON.
Toggle DM WATCH to monitor active chat interactions.
Toggle AUTOPILOT to enable automated AI responses for deal tracking.
jarvis_use: Track conversation lead stages and auto-transition deals based on user DM interaction.

name: prepackaged-zip-distribution
summary: Distribute pre-built local AI agent applications via OS-specific install ZIP packages for Mac and Windows.
steps: Download platform ZIP archive (e.g., spark-skill-v1-mac.zip or spark-skill-v1-windows.zip).
Unpack ZIP package into target working folder.
Execute bundled install guide PDF steps to launch pre-wired app environment.
jarvis_use: Package complex local agent setups into simplified OS-specific installers for rapid client deployment.
